description: Open the next edition now and start folding the public changes since the last one into entries. DESTRUCTIVE to an open draft: 'the next edition' is singular, so this DISCARDS any existing draft and everything a reviewer edited into it. Read get_changelog first and only re-prepare when you mean to re-roll the fold. The fold is an LLM job that runs in the background and costs credits: the row comes back with generationStatus QUEUED, and it reads QUEUED or RUNNING (RETRYING after a transient failure) while the fold runs and SUCCEEDED when it lands, so poll get_changelog for the entries. It does not publish anything. Requires the MANAGER role or above.
name: prepare_changelog_edition
title: Prepare changelog edition
